parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use the correct $\tan(A+B)$ formula and obtain an equation in $\tan x$, or an equation in $\cos x$ and $\sin x$. [M1] Accepted equations include $(\tan x+\tan45^\circ)/(1-\tan x\tan45^\circ)=2/\tan x$, allowing 2 in the denominator; or $(\sin x\cos45^\circ+\cos x\sin45^\circ)/(\cos x\cos45^\circ-\sin x\sin45^\circ)=2\cos x/\sin x$.
Obtain $\tan^2x+3\tan x-2=0$, or $3\sin x\cos x=2\cos^2x-\sin^2x$. [A1]
Solve a three-term quadratic in $\tan x$ and obtain a value for $x$. [M1]
Obtain $29.3^\circ$. [A1] Guidance: $29.316\ldots^\circ$.
Obtain $105.7^\circ$ and no other. [A1] Guidance: $105.583\ldots^\circ$; ignore answers outside the interval; treat radians as a misread. Total: 5.
